title: Linking a pull request to an issue
finding: One PR may close several issues with keywords; each closed issue lists the PR as linked.

title: Closing issues using keywords (GitHub Enterprise docs)
finding: Use a separate keyword per issue: `Resolves #10, resolves #123`.

title: github/github-mcp-server#3006
finding: closedByPullRequestsReferences is a plain list (with includeClosedPrs, totalCount); it does not mark a primary PR.

title: GitHub Community discussion #24367: Get referenced pull request from issue
finding: Linked PRs of an issue are available through GraphQL, not through a REST field.
